requirementsImplemented.note: Orthogonal SourceOrigin/UnitForm/ClaimStrength types were frozen in Phase 0 (source-use-plan v1, unchanged); the compiler now derives them independently — never one overloaded enum.
Sourced case / constructed application / generic scenario are validated compositions; the frozen validator rejects every forbidden combination (tested).

Direct conceptual explanation is a first-class minted unit per fact (concept_only, no cast/prop/scene demandable); rendered affirmatively on the card. Critic-side enforcement is IMP-04's package (integration note).

Per-unit plan at state/books/<book>/runs/<runId>/source-plans/chNN.plan.json (authoring-only): stable unitId, origin, form, claimStrength, caseId, anchorIds, allowed/forbidden detail categories, sufficiency, framing, sourcePacketSha256, planVersion, compilerVersion carrying the ownership marker.

compileSourcePackets (sole production packet writer) compiles+writes plans in the same pass; writers/repairs cannot mutate ownership fields (workspace isolation + reserved-key rejection + splice scan); disputes route upstream via the retry card.

Plan-hash lineage: sourcePlanHash + inputHashes on every attempt; entry/gate/pre-commit staleness rejection; prose-evidence invalidation rides existing content/doc hashes. Full evidence-graph invalidation lands with IMP-10 (contract slot already wired).

Named cases normalize into compact writer-safe policy: plan case units (categorical permissions, partial sufficiency, framing) + projection v2 doNotRestamp/naturalSetting; allowedUses/forbiddenUses boilerplate mapped categorically instead of copied.

Causal permission is never inferred from mechanism strings/sequence/association: mechanism→mechanistic ceiling, below-robust replication→descriptive, causal/inferential/correlational never minted; compiler self-checks its own ceiling and tests pin it.

Card projects only the compact policy + anchor IDs: projection 0.303x packet; plan block 2,330 chars grouped; bulky provenance/ranking/anchor bodies stay out (allowlist test extended by exactly the four safety fields).
Combinations validate before authoring: fail-closed at entry (invalid/stale/corrupt plans refuse to spawn), at the source-packet gate (SP15/SP16 blockers), and at pre-commit freshness.

Backward compatible: absent plan = byte-identical legacy path (pinned); absence grants nothing; empty anchor catalogs mint no source-bound units (loudly). No persisted schema changed; plans mint on next compile-source-packets.

renderUntrustedSourceBlock generalized into the typed envelope (src/exec/untrustedArtifact.ts): artifact type, stable id, version, content sha256, stable delimiters, fence escalation, delimiter-forgery defusal. Adopted at author-card projection/complaints and repair-card criteria/advisories.

Control-authority quarantine is structural: policy resolved pre-card and never parsed from artifact data (frozen FINDING_FORBIDDEN_CONTROL_FIELDS covers structured findings); spawn-boundary test proves injection payloads cannot alter the resolved route/profile. Lexical detection deliberately not attempted (IMP-02 lesson).

Plan/packet/projection/brief/renderer hashes bind into the card (plan hash line), attempt identity (sourcePlanHash + inputHashes), and the freshness lineage; missing/conflicting/stale hashes reject at entry, gate, and commit.

Package exclusion: plans live under runs/<runId>/source-plans/ (never read by promote/publish; publishToLive copies exactly one file); chapters cannot carry plan fields (reserved-key rejection at the only canonical write path); public chapter schema untouched.

inferential/correlational strengths are dormant until research emits an explicit relation field; ladder is effectively descriptive/mechanistic today.
Card grew +665 (envelope) and +~2,330 on plan-bearing books; W1 fixture pin raised 18,940 → 20,000 with history note — IMP-05 owns the diet (conflict-matrix order: data first, diet second).
The write-contract D7 lead rule still pressures a named lead through fastRead+2 examples; reconciling it with explanation-unit rights is IMP-04 scope.
